backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling user profiles with access control and storing customer inquiries with create and list operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of all frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and color‑token setup defining light/dark theme CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App root configuring TanStack Router, React Query, theming, and global toaster.
frontend/src/components/admin/InquiriesT: Admin table that lists customer inquiries, handling loading, error, and empty states with UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button integrating Internet Identity authentication and handling login state feedback.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal form that collects a user's name and saves their profile via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section showing phone numbers, info cards, and embeds the inquiry form.
frontend/src/components/GallerySection.t: Image gallery presenting generated brand, product, and service images in a grid.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with branding text, CTA buttons, and a featured hero image.
frontend/src/components/InquiryForm.tsx: Customer inquiry form that submits name, phone, and message using a mutation hook and displays success or error toasts.
Displays categorized product listings with badges in a grid layout for mobile accessories.
Renders a services showcase with icons, descriptions, and an image highlighting available mobile-related services.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, quick navigation links, contact numbers, and a copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with logo and responsive navigation that scrolls to page sections and supports a mobile menu.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login/logout functions, and loads stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsAdmin.ts: Query hook that checks whether the current authenticated caller has admin privileges.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profile operations and inquiry creation/listing using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for light and dark UI modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page handling authentication, profile setup, admin checks, and rendering inquiries for admins.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page assembling main site sections such as hero, services, products, gallery, and contact.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores the project's state, feature list, image requirements, and metadata for ongoing build planning.
